lines.text: It's almost time... Why isn't Tangtang here yet?

options: (Better look for her. Hope nothing bad happened.)

lines.text: So many footprints, and in such a mess. Looks like a fight... Tangtang has been ambushed!
I must find her quickly!
Trying to take me down?! Not in this lifetime, losers! Not even in eight friggin lifetimes!
Quit struggling already, little dame. This is the day you pay for Big Bro's death!

scenes.summary: You defeat Ruan Yi's loyalists and find out that Tangtang has been wounded. After treating her injuries, you decide to chase down the fleeing Dirt Rinser.

lines.text: I'm alright. I rushed a dodge, but tripped and scraped my knee. A gentle rub should fix it.
Ugh. If it weren't for that fall, I would've dominated the battle.
Like, I'd be totally untouchable — OUCH! Sssss!
No, it's okay! I can just walk this off!
Darkmask, where's your manners?! I'm your Chief, you don't order me around!
HSSSS... It burns! Urrrggh! Those little shits ambushed me!
I got a bit careless. Those bastards caught me off guard...
Wow! It's not hurting anymore... Not bad!
That bastard's probably in his hideout. Let's go!

options: Just show me your wounds. I got some meds.
Stop fidgeting and let me dress the wounds.

lines.text: Patience, little one!
If you want eggs, spook a fowlbeast and follow it back to its roost.
⟦key|Uncle Shang⟧'s gang often acts in groups. He's definitely trying to find his people and get back home.
Heheh. But those losers think I grew up pampered and spoiled by my brother.
They're friggin wrong. I'm his best apprentice and next-in-line. Now, why won't anyone mention that?
Ugh... Enough about this. Let's find where that little tweety-fowl ran off to.

options: Impressive. You actually got plenty of tricks.
Never expected you to have so many tricks.

scenes.summary: Tangtang and you follow Dirt Rinser's footprints and track him down. You also acquire the location of the loyalist hideout.

lines.text: See! Your Chief got it all figured out!
Took you long enough, slow poke... Geez! What happened to your hand?!
It's nothing. Just ran into that little whiny snot...
Why the hell mess with her? We were told to leave her alone. ⟦key|Uncle Shang⟧ will flog you raw.
And we got a fair bit of punting after this. I don't know if your messed-up hand is up for the job.
Cut the crap. I can punt just as well with one arm.
One-arm punting? Gimme a break. River fog is thick as porridge today. The Ancestral Spring will swallow you whole if you aren't careful.
The fog... And the raft... OH! I know where the place is! Ugh. That's why Big Bro...
Follow me!

options: A cunning strategist you are, Chief!
Let's try to hear what they're discussing.
